provenance: Hand-authored expected packet/state fixtures. Seeded drop choices frozen on 2026-10-16. No sensor recordings or production code supplied.
limitations: This is a new specification model. The supplied remote repository had no production source; there is no shared encoder/decoder implementation or Swift/C++ parity evidence yet.

The packet is exactly nine bytes with no checksum, timestamp, sender boot ID, or sensor-health field. Valid-byte corruption and old packets after 256 sequence values are not detectable from these bytes alone.
Band 0 means no pin request. It cannot distinguish free space, unknown depth, lost tracking, stopped input, or a model timeout. Highlight on a zero band cannot raise a target pin.

Sequence observe/forward_only, exact timeout boundary, disconnect behavior, freshness thresholds, field of view, edge rounding, conflict resolution, neutral choices and timing are reference policies pending recovery of docs/PROTOCOL.md and production code.

Nominal gap angles derive from the handoff; 40 ms gap / 120 ms settling are configurable unmeasured illustrations. These phases do not demonstrate collision freedom, physical pin return, no neighboring-pin activation, torque, or timing.

Synthetic inputs are already grouped into seven sectors. Pose is metadata only. No ARKit projection, camera orientation, CoreML, UWB, BLE radio, mechanical model, servo output, or physical control is present.
No live sensor data appears anywhere in this replay. Every view is SIMULATION. Future production adapters must pass the golden vectors and their own device/build tests.

scenarios.description: A receiver starts empty. Mixed band bytes select at most one logical pin per column; this is not physical motion.

events.label: Reference settling time elapsed; actual motion unknown

scenarios.description: Reference timeout occurs exactly 500 ms after the last accepted receipt. Time is virtual and monotonic.

events.label: Timeout is latched, not repeatedly counted

scenarios.description: Nominal reference command phases use unmeasured 40 ms gap and 120 ms settling. They cannot prove pins clear during travel.

events.label: Request changed bands and clear three columns

scenarios.description: Length, band and highlight validation rejects bad payloads without refreshing the receipt watchdog.
The one-byte sequence rolls from 255 to 0. It does not encode absolute age or wrap count.
Sequence 10 -> 13 suggests two missing sequence values under a short-gap assumption, not proven radio loss.
Default observe policy accepts duplicates and ambiguous backward traffic because the handoff defines no ordering policy. This exposes stale-data risk.

events.label: Possibly old packet accepted: explicit contract gap

scenarios.description: Optional synthetic half-range ordering rejects duplicates / backward-or-large-gap packets and forgets sequence after timeout. This is not claimed production behavior.

events.label: Repeated stale traffic cannot hold model active

scenarios.description: Reference connection policy immediately requests neutral on disconnect and waits for a new packet after reconnect.
Synthetic upstream tracking loss sends all-zero bands / no highlight immediately. No real ARKit tracking is exercised.
Synthetic depth older than 250 ms clears output. Exact freshness edges and clock meaning are reference choices.

events.label: Age 250 ms is accepted in this policy
Age 251 ms is rejected in this policy

scenarios.description: Synthetic target disappearance clears highlight; two target candidates suppress highlight. Neither changes obstacle bands.
A synthetic detector result older than 250 ms is ignored even with fresh depth. No network or inference engine is simulated.
Band interval edges are explicit: [0.3,0.9), [0.9,1.6), [1.6,2.5), [2.5,4.0]. Positive closer readings saturate to band 1 by default.

events.label: Unknown readings and values below boundaries

scenarios.description: The packet has no checksum: flipping band 1 to legal band 0 is accepted. PASS means the limitation was demonstrated, not that corruption is safe.
Committed loss decisions from Python random.Random(20261016), 12 draws with p(drop)=0.4. Events are replayed as fixed fixtures.
Synthetic pose is metadata only, not an implemented camera transform. Missing depth selects 0 without claiming free space.

events.label: Pose metadata changes; sector fixtures remain independent

scenarios.description: The wire contract allows hl on an empty column. This model keeps the empty band and shows only a highlight request, without inventing a target-distance pin.

events.label: Timeout clears even an empty highlight
